messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Payments are being held up, causing suppliers to inquire.
  quote: Appreciate that — it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions.
- problem: Handlers cannot complete reserve changes because there is no delegated approver, causing claim processing to stall.
  quote: We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up. Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup — approval waiting list is blocking everything.
- problem: Webhook retries are delayed, causing real‑time claim processing and policyholder update issues.
  quote: We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time.
- problem: Reserve authorisation delay blocks all actions when a reserve change exceeds handler limits.
  quote: Yes, it’s specifically when a reserve change exceeds handler limits — the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.
- problem: Claims are stuck because the approver is unavailable and no one is covering their queue.
  quote: we’ve got a few claims held up because the approver’s out and no one’s covering their queue.
- problem: Claims are stuck waiting for approval because there is no backup approver.
  quote: we’ve got a couple of ... claims held up because the ... approver’s ...  …  …  …  ...  … ... … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … …… …………………………………………………………
- problem: The approval waiting list is delaying payments and supplier invoices.
  quote: Exactly. It’s not just inconvenient — it’s holding up payments and supplier invoices too.
- problem: Handlers cannot get reserve adjustments approved when the required approver is out of office and has no delegate, causing delays.
  quote: We’re experiencing a reserve authorisation delay because when a handler tries to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it sits waiting for one specific approver who’s out of office and has no delegate assigned, so nothing moves.
